release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.25 randomizes all six player seat positions on every new cash table. Updating or closing Pigeon Poker now commits all open-table HERO stacks to the shared SQLite wallet in one idempotent transaction; a failed cash-out prevents shutdown so table chips are not silently discarded. The release also applies a one-time $5,000 wallet recovery credit for the open-table update loss reported by the user. The credit is written to the shared wallet ledger and protected against duplicate application. Existing VIP PRO/TOP PRO lineup, 1,024/4,096 postflop simulations, 80 BB to 100 BB auto-rebuy, 174-scenario preflop policy, casino games, and all-in staged reveals remain intact.
